description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 19.06.2017 to 25.06.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content directly relates to the establishment of a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for customs operations, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
